machine: local (archlinux, AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor, 12 threads, 15910 MB)

split.note: The .blzg's fit and validation rows, as `blz prepare` stored them with V2 D-17's boundary rule at both cuts (SPEC v3 §6.3). Every run mines [0, 2,423,336) (`--triggers train`); the test rows [2,423,336, 3,029,170) are neither mined nor read.

v1_check_summary: clean_e16_q8 under `--quirks all` (every oracle quirk, plus Q8's histograms) reproduces v1_e16 on every block of these rows: deg_in, deg_out, fan_in, fan_out, lcyc, sg, tcyc against v1_e16 by output hash, the others row by row (the vertex statistics bit for bit against `blz vstats --window 86400`), and sg_ord against V2's sg_ordered (sg_ordered_v1w) mined on the same rows on the oracle. AC-V2-0's hashes are HI-Small's and are not checked.

classifier.xgb: V2 R0's settings: scale_pos_weight 1, max_depth 6, 100 rounds, eta 0.3, hist, base_score estimated from the fit labels
classifier.note: V2 R0's XGBoost settings (`configs/xgb_default.yaml`: library defaults, 100 rounds, threshold 0.5), fit on the fit rows. Every fit has the same base, the DG-2 ladder's carried ids and raw columns: v1 `src_id`, `dst_id` and S2 (Amount Sent, Sent Currency, Amount Received, Received Currency, Payment Format, with Multi-GNN's codes). Then the vertex statistics (52 columns, clipped to the float32 range) and the pattern blocks in v1's order, sg_ord and lcyc last.

notes: clean_e16's 4 draws (the unweighted fit, then 3 refits on block-bootstrapped fit rows, 100 chunks, the same weights for every configuration) give F1 28.93, 31.10, 35.26, 37.91 and PR-AUC 0.159, 0.146, 0.200, 0.199. The [95%] column covers only the validation sample's noise.
Configurations that change no block row on the fit or validation rows: Q1, Q3, Q7, Q8 (Q7 drops sg_ord and counts as unchanged when its other blocks are).
The fit and validation rows hold 23 self-loops, 11 of them laundering.
564 of the 1,406 fit and validation positives that share their timestamp sit in the first tenth of its rows (mean relative rank 0.578 on fit and 0.577 on validation; negatives 0.500 and 0.500).
u_out's time mean: 99.7% of validation rows lie above its fit maximum under Q10 (absolute timestamps), 99.7% under v1_e16 and 0.0% under clean's ages.
No test label is read. Every run mines [0, 2,423,336), labels are read for those rows only, and only validation rows are scored.
R0's settings (`configs/xgb_default.yaml`), not a tuned recipe: only the paired differences are read.
Count blocks: instances = rows with a count of at least 1 (one instance per trigger, R7). The ≥ 2 share is what v1's histogram marks active.
Timings are informal (P13); the load before each run is logged with it.
